title: Appeals, Reactivation and Account Closure under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Terms.** A deactivated Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account is reactivated in one of two ways.

- A **documents expired** deactivation is reactivated by the agent once a renewed document with an expiry date after the reactivation date is on file, without an appeal.
- Any other appealable cause needs an **appeal submitted by the shopper**, and an appeal is accepted only when it is submitted within the appeal window counted from the deactivation date. The appeal window is counted in calendar days with the deactivation date as day 0, and the last day to appeal is the deactivation date plus the level's appeal window days, inclusive. Only the reasons the level lists as appealable can be appealed.

The appeals team decides within the level's decision target; an upheld appeal reactivates the account, and a denied one closes it with the reason "appeal denied". An account that has already received the level's lifetime maximum of reactivations cannot be reactivated again. A reactivated account returns at the level its terms set. An account deactivated and not appealed within the window is closed with the reason "appeal window lapsed". A shopper may close an active account at any time (reason "voluntary").

## Figures by level

| Level | Appeal window (calendar days) | Decision target (business days) | Appealable reasons | Lifetime reactivations | Returns at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 14 | 10 | Rating below floor, violation points, documents expired | 1 | The same level |
| Full-Service Shopper | 30 | 10 | The three above and zero-tolerance violation | 1 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 30 | 10 | The same four | 1 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 30 | 7 | The same four | 2 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 45 | 5 | The same four | 2 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 45 | 5 | The same four | 2 | The entry level |

## The appeal window at its edges (hypothetical dates)

A Full-Service Shopper Silver account is deactivated on 1 April, day 0. 1 April plus 30 days is 1 May.

| Appeal submitted on | Accepted |
|---|---|
| 1 May | Yes — the last day is included |
| 2 May | No; with no appeal in the window the account is closed as appeal window lapsed |

## Points of judgement

- *Reactivation count.* The account record's count of reactivations received decides the limit: a Full-Service Shopper Platinum account showing 2 cannot be reactivated again; one showing 1 can.
- *Documents expired.* No appeal is needed; what matters is a renewed document on file whose expiry date is after the reactivation date.
- *Zero-tolerance at Shop-Only Shopper.* It is not among the appealable reasons at that level.
